description: Morphe patches for BitChord 1.9: Telegram music, a Downloads explorer, Soulseek sharing, Telegram archives, mixed-source playlists, Automix Editor and playback tools.

patches.name: Audio and video switch
patches.description: Adds a song and video switch to the top of the player, as in YouTube Music: one tap plays a song's music video, or the song again, in the same place in the queue. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Automix Editor
patches.description: Measures the selected playable source, verifies automatic replacements, preserves playback speed and adds a native, pair-specific transition timeline with volume, EQ, filter controls and preview.

patches.name: Battery saver
patches.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: DJ mode
patches.description: Orders upcoming tracks by measured key and tempo. Choose Steady, Build up or Wind down, use longer AutoMix blends for compatible keys, or save the order to a local playlist. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Diagnostics
patches.description: Records bounded application and patch events for troubleshooting, including startup and sign-in failures. Recording starts only when requested and stops after 15 minutes. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Equaliser per output
patches.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Headphone correction
patches.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

options.description: The app name on your home screen, up to 80 characters. Leave blank for Bitchord+. A name containing Telegram must include Unofficial Telegram.

patches.name: JamesDSP
patches.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Karaoke
patches.description: Turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song, with a Karaoke control at the bottom right of the lyrics. Ported from the vocal remover in Auris by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. Choose the filter or on-device separation model. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Loudness level
patches.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches.description: Adds signed-out playlist links, editable device copies, queue saving, native file import and reviewed two-way Spotify/YouTube Music playlist sync. Keeps files and streams together with full source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Per-download quality
patches.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Pitch control
patches.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Play alongside other apps
patches.description: Keeps the music playing when another app plays sound, such as a reel or a video, instead of pausing. Calls still pause it. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Smart downloads
patches.description: Downloads the songs you play most, on Wi-Fi, so they're there without a signal. Uses BitChord's listening statistics and its Download quality; songs you delete aren't downloaded again. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Steady playback
patches.description: Reads further ahead, through the rest of the song and into the next ones, with separate limits for Wi-Fi and mobile data, and waits through a lost signal instead of stopping. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Streamseek previews
patches.description: Preview explicitly selected Soulseek audio while it transfers: FLAC, WAV/AIFF, ALAC, APE, WavPack, TTA/TAK, WMA Lossless and DSD, plus MP3. A dedicated on-device FFmpeg decoder feeds Media3. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.

patches.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches.description: Adds player-integrated Downloads on BitChord 1.9, addon/Soulseek source choices, batch review, selected-file public Soulseek sharing, and verified Telegram archiving/restore. Telegram copies require the optional Telegram patch and your private main channel. Debrid services use your API keys. Live Soulseek playback stays disabled. Settings are in Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.

patches.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

options.description: Leave at 0 and enter your API ID in the app after installing.
Leave empty and enter your API hash in the app after installing.

release_notes:
In Morphe, refresh the [testing source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/refs/heads/testing/patches-bundle.json) and select an original BitChord 1.9.1 or 1.9 APK.
For updates, use the same package and signing key to preserve app data.

- Support the BitChord 1.9.1 universal APK for shared audio, Telegram and Soulseek. Unsupported 32-bit x86 libraries are removed; ARM64, ARMv7 and x86-64 remain available.

- **Unofficial Telegram** catches up a delayed quality upgrade before fading it in. If the copies cannot be aligned, the current audio keeps playing.

- Fix a startup crash on BitChord 1.9.1 with **Unofficial Telegram** or **Soulseek** installed.

- **Automix Editor** keeps the waveform layout steady through a continuous swipe, including swipes that reach the start of the settings. A fresh pull at the start expands the waveform.
- **Diagnostics** records AutoMix failure stages, memory waits, preview loading times, buffering, source errors and why a preview stopped.

- **Automix Editor** reads downloaded files directly for track analysis and waveform loading.
- **Audio and video switch** refreshes lyrics when the active recording’s length arrives late and preserves a chosen provider across a version with no result.

- **Automix Editor** analyzes queued tracks with missing durations and uses the selected file’s duration when its queue label is rounded.

- **Karaoke** uses smaller model working buffers. Read-ahead stays bounded while the model is loaded, and background decoding waits when heap headroom is low.

- **Automix Editor** reuses native analysis, timing and beat matching unless an explicit tempo override is saved. Deck headers show measured keys and tempo with low-confidence indicators, and Preview waits for an actual automatic plan.

- **Automix Editor** follows the playing pair without discarding drafts, prioritises the outgoing waveform and retries failed waveform requests. Queue analysis prepares one additional readable local or fully cached track when current and next analysis have settled.

- Playlist and album downloads expand source results inside each track card, with reported format filters, duration, size and selected-source details. Each original duration stays visible beside the selected copy’s reported duration.
- Tapping a completed download opens BitChord’s local player. Its recorded source stays available for local playback, and FLAC tag updates preserve existing metadata when no replacement is supplied.

- **Karaoke** (formerly Sing) adds a microphone control directly above Translate in the lyrics. Tapping it switches on separation-model vocal removal and opens a vertical slider linked to the settings slider; after it closes, the microphone stays faintly visible and can be tapped to reopen the slider.
- **Diagnostics** records app and patch events for startup and sign-in troubleshooting. Start and stop capture explicitly, then share a compressed report through Android’s share menu.
- **Audio and video switch** carries a manual lyrics-provider choice between versions of the same queued song and reloads lyrics for the active version.
- Returning to audio clears the video-origin flag so native AutoMix can analyse and blend the song again. Fullscreen can follow the player's request when the window ignores rotation, with Back handled in the player's scope.
- The player's **Download** control uses the current downloadable non-YouTube stream first, then matching alternatives ranked by quality. YouTube is the last fallback when enabled; the control shows the download queue's reported percentage.
- **Transition editor** restores the full waveform when scrolling back to the top, offers an overlap slider and separates draft saving from applying a transition.
- **Automix Editor** has uniform controls, separate track-tempo and matching controls, and adjustable filter depth. Explicit overlap rates keep pitch and return to the listener’s speed after the blend.
- Track analysis accounts separately for decoding and measurement memory, and offers Retry when repeated memory rejections prevent analysis.
- **Automix Editor** loads device audio and reverses preview order without changing listening. **Use this pair** explicitly changes the current and next queue entries; opening a draft does not apply it.
- Draft changes in **Automix Editor** survive rotation without an older delayed save overwriting them.
- Fixed: Google sign-in handles links to other apps without opening an unknown-scheme error page.
- **YouTube Music** can be turned off from Sources. Playback only stops YouTube audio and Full disable also stops its search and browsing; songs use saved files, matching local music or another enabled source, with **No audio track found** shown when none has playable audio.
- **DJ mode** orders upcoming tracks by key and tempo with Steady, Build up and Wind down choices. Compatible keys receive longer blends; Save DJ order updates a local playlist after confirmation.
- **Unofficial Telegram music** updates the saved index when audio and ZIP posts arrive, change or disappear while connected.
- **DJ mode** leaves queue order to native shuffle while shuffle is on. **Audio and video switch** respects music-only playback and manual version changes.
- **Battery saver** stands down for native AutoMix even without **Automix Editor** installed. **Equaliser per output** leaves the native equaliser off while JamesDSP controls effects.
- Supports BitChord **1.9.1** and its experimental **1.9.1-beta1** build alongside 1.9.
- The player's **Audio/Video** pair is centred above the playback-origin caption. **Automix Editor** opens from a separate waveform icon below the stats; the icons follow BitChord's player colours and blending.
- **Automix Editor** is the patch name for source-aware transition analysis and pair editing. Its preset options remain scrollable, with compact Save draft and Apply controls.
- **Downloads** offers a default audio folder through Android’s picker, including writable folders on SD cards and USB drives. New transfers keep their selected destination through pause and retry.
- Completed files in selected folders use Android’s document-provider delete operation. A failed deletion keeps the saved entry.
- YouTube video preparation uses less memory when handling cipher scripts.

Known limits: [Known limitations](https://github.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/blob/v1.1.0-beta.19/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
